verdict.rationale: Orama's GitHub feature list includes 'Pinning Rules (Merchandising)' and 'Fields Boosting', which are its own controls for shaping result order beyond plain textual matching. However, these are only bare feature-list mentions. Nothing shows ranking driven by business signals such as popularity, recency or margin. missing for 10: documented custom ranking or score functions using numeric business signals (popularity, recency, margin), detailed docs on how pinning rules and boosting work, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can shape relevance with custom ranking rules and business signals (popularity, recency, margin) beyond textual matching
